title: On the Fractional Parts of Polynomials Modulo $p$
summary: We study a half-interval distribution problem for polynomial residues modulo an odd prime $p$: how often the fractional part of $\varphi(x)/p$ lies in the upper half of the unit interval as $x$ ranges over $1\leq x \frac12\right\} =\frac{p}{4}+O_\varphi(\sqrt p\log^2 p). $ We then show that the error term can be improved to $O_\varphi(\sqrt p\log p)$ for arbitrary quadratic polynomials and for polynomials satisfying suitable reflection symmetries.
